artifacts.synopsis: An elder appealed Presbytery’s elevation, without additional process, of suspensions from office and the Sacraments to deposition and excommunication. The SJC granted the appeal, reversed in whole, and remanded, restoring the prior suspensions. Elevation required a hearing on incorrigibility and contumacy—with a charge, evidence, plea, and defense—but not a full de novo trial; disagreement with the original verdict alone was insufficient. The SJC left unresolved deposition from office when excommunication is absent.

artifacts.title: Adams v. Northeast Presbytery
artifacts.synopsis: A prosecutor's complaint relating to Northeast Presbytery's judicial case was held administratively out of order by the SJC. The SJC adopted two grounds: BCO 43-1 bars a complaint about a matter subject to an appeal in another case, and the complaint sought retrial of an accused on charges of which he had been acquitted, relief the SJC could not grant. Although the related appeal was later withdrawn and the withdrawal approved, the SJC still applied BCO 43-1. A concurrence disputed that first ground and urged BCO clarification of appellate review of acquittals. No merits ruling was made.

artifacts.title: Systematic overhaul of BCO judicial process chapters 31, 32, and 35

matches.evidence: Overture proposing broad changes to BCO 31, 32, and 35 governing judicial process was found in grave conflict with multiple BCO provisions but adopted 8-0-0.

artifacts.title: Requiring church officers to testify in disciplinary proceedings

matches.evidence: An overture to compel church officer testimony was possibly in conflict with BCO 35-3 and 35-4 regarding the two-witness requirement and exclusion of witnesses during others' testimony.
